description: A power strip lies on the bed near a white square charger block with a white cable, and there’s another loose black cord nearby in front of the pillow. The left hand moves in toward the power strip, then shifts left to grasp the white charger block as a left-hand object, lifting it and bringing it to the right above the power strip as if lining its plug up with a socket, while the right hand stays to the right and hovers near the strip without touching it.
